h:
我出于基本的 text2img 目的创建了此工作流程，并希望将其分享给所有想要简单且可用的工作流程而无需任何额外内容的人。

要使用 Groq LLM 节点，请确保遵循此处的说明：https://civitai.com/articles/4997（我在新版本中删除了 Groq 节点）。

检查“关于此版本”以查找每个版本的增量更改。

最新：

  • 使工作流程组完全模块化，每个组的输入和输出都重新路由。

  • 彻底改造工作流程。让初学者更容易理解。

  • 添加了对控制网的支持。 （我推荐SDXL 的控制网络联盟)

  • 添加了对使用 Comfy Couple 节点的简单区域提示的支持。

  • 为 AYS、非 AYS 和 SD3 添加了不同的采样器，并使其更容易在它们之间切换。

  • 面部细节器和手部细节器节点已调整值以获得更好的整体性能。

  • SDXL 和 SD1.5 LoRA 之间的切换现在应该更容易了。

o.en:
I created this workflow for basic text2img purposes, and would like to share this to everyone who wants a simple and usable workflow without any extra stuff.

To use the Groq LLM nodes, make sure to follow the instructions here:https://civitai.com/articles/4997(I removed the Groq nodes in the newer versions).

Check "About this version" to find the incremental changes with each version.

LATEST:

  • Made the workflow groups completely modular, with input and output reroutes for every group.

  • Complete revamp of the workflow. Made things much easier for beginners to understand.

  • Added support for controlnets. (I recommendcontrolnet union for SDXL)

  • Added support for simple Regional Prompting using Comfy Couple nodes.

  • Added different samplers for AYS, non-AYS, and SD3, and made it easier to switch between them.

  • Face detailer and Hand detailer nodes have tweaked values for overall better performance.

  • Switching between SDXL and SD1.5 LoRAs should be easier now.
